# Accepted terms for Tiger Data Docs.
# One term per line (case-insensitive regex). These are treated as correctly
# spelled, so Google's spelling rules don't flag them.
#
# IMPORTANT: do NOT list any term that TigerData.ProductConstants enforces
# (Tiger Cloud, TimescaleDB, hypertable, columnstore, CLI, VPC, ...). The Vocab
# globally suppresses all rules for a term, which would silence that nudge.
# The generator (scripts/generate-vale-product-constants.ts) warns if an
# enforced value is found here. Correct usage writes those as {C.X} anyway.

# --- Tiger / Timescale terms that are NOT constants ---
Tiger Lake
